body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 814ded3e835062be652f224aa95c2d1f24159b85 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The new warning is advisory. Existing blocking warnings remain in the result. The MCP finding and UI fold use separate identifiers. Both new regression tests detect their intended mutations.

Requested before merge:

1. `crates/ui/src/operations.rs:308`: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body. Show the changed warning display. The body currently has no screenshots. Store the images only on the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch, and link them from the body.
2. `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:3589`: Run the reached heavy lanes on the final head. Record the lanes and results in the body. The body explicitly says they did not run. Current upstream `AGENTS.md`, "Heavy lanes at review", requires these results before readiness. This change adds warnings to Adaptive results, so existing zero-warning assertions need verification. Use `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main`. A dry run reaches the motion and app heavy lanes. I did not run these release lanes. Not run is not a pass.

Local results:

The PR was trial-merged without conflicts with upstream main `c310c4f61`. No GitHub runner was used. The worktree had its own target directory.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` completed 373 steps: 372 passed and one failed. All four crate builds passed. Test totals:

| Crate | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| sim | 412 | 0 | 1 |
| motion | 1282 | 2 | 58 |
| app | 1817 | 0 | 27 |
| ui | 1446 | 0 | 7 |

Changed app suites passed: `adaptive_pinch` (1), `adaptive_zero_margin_island` (4), `climb_direction` (2), `shoulder_adaptive` (7), and `strategy_fallback` (1). The motion library passed 491 tests. The UI library passed 1379 tests from `crates/ui`, including the warning-fold regression. All selected UI integration suites passed.

The failed step was `motion suites: vertical_arc_entry`:

```text
an_x_aligned_first_cut_enters_on_one_g18_arc_per_level
crates/motion/tests/vertical_arc_entry.rs:176
recorded path vertical_arc_x.cl is stale
recorded moves=22; generated moves=20

an_oblique_first_cut_stays_chords_and_says_so_once
crates/motion/tests/vertical_arc_entry.rs:214
each level still descends on a chord fan
```

I replaced the four changed motion files with their current upstream versions in this worktree. I ran `cargo test -p camcraft-motion --test vertical_arc_entry` again. Both failures reproduced, with the same CL mismatch. I then restored all four files. These are baseline failures, not additional findings against this PR. The quick gate remains red.

`cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Mutations run by this reviewer:

- Remove the warning insertion from generate: the app pin failed at `strategy_fallback.rs:46`, with zero warnings instead of one. Restore it: one test passed.
- Make `rings_fallbacks` match no notes: the motion pin failed at `hsm_fallback_tests.rs:82`, with zero instead of one. Restore it: one test passed.

All mutation edits were restored. No contributor code or golden was changed. No golden file moves in this PR. The two note-format changes preserve their text.

Extra suites run:

- Neither extra-suite trigger applies. The PR changes no fixture directory, testdata file, or importer code.
- Baseline diagnostic: `camcraft-motion --test vertical_arc_entry` (one passed, two failed).
- The two mutation pins were each run with the mutation and after restoration.

Notes: Existing large source files grow further. This is nonblocking under the reviewer rules. The PR is partial work on #3035, so `Refs #3035` is appropriate.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed:

1. Warning display screenshots. The PR body now links both real UI renders from the fork's images-only `pr-screenshots` branch.
   The temporary `capture_3108_warning_before_after` test passed. It checks the real generated Adaptive fixture.
   Before omits only the new cached advisory. After restores the exact generated cache. The capture code is removed.

2. Heavy lane verification. The final head passes all 235 reached heavy steps for motion and app.
   Six stale assertions now accept only the fallback that the path notes describe.
   They require the same area count and a nonblocking warning. Other warnings still fail.
   Geometry checks and configured known-failure assertions remain unchanged.

Pins:

- `adaptive_pinch::the_users_part_with_default_adaptive_keeps_the_cutter_off_it`
- `pick_agnostic::a_face_with_an_island_and_its_rim_loop_cut_the_same_bytes_around_the_boss_full`
- `pocket3d_hsm::the_users_whole_model_bore_roughs_adaptive_on_each_level`
- `shoulder_adaptive::containment_outside_clears_past_the_edge_never_the_recess`
- `shoulder_adaptive::fig8_outside_containment_with_em0800_and_clearing_kinds_works`
- `whole_model_pocket::a_whole_part_adaptive_at_the_default_load_keeps_the_full_tool_radius_off_the_part`

Mutation: remove the warning insertion. All six pins fail at the strict warning guard.
Restore it: the targeted gate passes nine steps. Both affected known-failure tests reach their original expected reasons.

Final verification:

- Quick gate: 313 steps, zero failures.
- Heavy gate: 235 steps, zero gate failures. Motion has 57 ordinary passes and two expected baseline failures. App has 43 ordinary passes and four expected baseline failures.
- Clippy: sim, motion, app and UI pass with all targets and `-D warnings`.

Head: `9562dd2adc3f0cb36a90d7103fb1eb6c5a84f039`.

Please re-review this head.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9562dd2adc3f0cb36a90d7103fb1eb6c5a84f039 -->
Source review is clean. The branch conflicts with main.

Both findings from the earlier review are met:

1. The body links before/after screenshots. I opened both images. They show the warning count and the expanded advisory. The image commit belongs to the fork's `pr-screenshots` history. No images are on this PR branch.
2. The body now records the reached heavy lanes on this final head. The author reports 235 steps with zero gate failures. Motion has 57 ordinary passes and two expected known failures. App has 43 ordinary passes and four expected known failures. I checked the six revised warning guards. They reject other warning types and require the area count from the notes. The geometry assertions and expected failure boundaries stay unchanged. I did not rerun these heavy lanes.

The new advisory is appended after verification. Existing blocking warnings stay in the result. The two note-format changes preserve their text. No golden file moves. No posted G-code, stock algorithm, or geometry algorithm changes. I used the safety review checks because verification warnings and the display of blocking warnings change.

Local build and tests:

The trial merge used upstream main `6ffa808aebffe41824b36005b885b62a66ac1950`. It conflicts in these files:

- `crates/app/src/mcp/job.rs`: warning mapping.
- `crates/app/tests/pick_agnostic.rs`: selection handling and warning assertions.
- `crates/sim/src/verify/types.rs`: warning variants.
- `crates/ui/src/operations.rs`: warning groups.

I aborted the merge without resolving code. All results below are for the PR head, not a merged tree. The review used its own local worktree and target directory. No GitHub runner was used.

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` completed 313 steps in 66.4 minutes. All four crate builds passed. The initial run had 312 passing steps and one failed timing check:

| Crate | Passed | Failed | Ignored |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| sim | 412 | 0 | 1 |
| motion | 1075 | 1 | 56 |
| app | 1671 | 0 | 28 |
| ui | 1402 | 0 | 7 |

The failed step was `motion suites: adaptive_troch_parallel`:

```text
wide_rectangular_pocket_is_cleared_by_parallel_lanes
crates/motion/tests/adaptive_troch_parallel.rs:18:5
wide pocket debug fixture exceeds 90 seconds: 116.239834917s
```

I checked the timing failure with the four changed motion files restored to the merge-base versions at `211105042b817a5b32fdf2c971d42e6d968297c6`. The isolated test passed in 62.72 seconds. The full baseline suite passed both tests in 64.79 seconds. I restored the PR files byte for byte. The full suite then passed both tests on this head in 65.22 seconds, with the gate's test concurrency. The initial timeout did not reproduce. The full quick run remains recorded as one failed step; its local retry passed.

Changed app suites passed: `adaptive_pinch` (1), `adaptive_zero_margin_island` (4), `climb_direction` (2), `pick_agnostic` (5), `pocket3d_hsm` (2), `shoulder_adaptive` (7), `strategy_fallback` (1), and `whole_model_pocket` (5). Ignored heavy tests are covered by the author's separate evidence above.

The motion library passed 489 tests. The UI library passed 1371 tests from `crates/ui`, including `a_drill_undersize_never_hides_an_avoid_hit`. The UI operations suite passed 31 tests.

`cargo clippy -j 8 -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` passed.

Mutations run by this reviewer:

- Remove the fallback warning insertion from generate: the app pin failed at `strategy_fallback.rs:46`, with zero warnings instead of one. Restore it: one test passed.
- Make `rings_fallbacks` match no notes: the motion pin failed at `hsm_fallback_tests.rs:82`, with zero instead of one. Restore it: one test passed.

All temporary changes were restored byte for byte. The worktree is clean. No review evidence was committed.

Extra suites run:

- Neither extra-suite trigger applies. No testdata, fixture, golden directory, or importer code changes.
- `camcraft-motion --test adaptive_troch_parallel`: baseline diagnostic and PR-head retry, as listed above.
- Both mutation pins ran with the mutation and after restoration.

Requested code changes: none. The branch needs a refresh before merge. Preserve both warning variants and their separate display groups during that refresh. The merged tree still needs its gate.

Notes: Existing large source files grow further. This is nonblocking under the reviewer rules. `Refs #3035` is appropriate for this partial fix.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
